description: A React component named CaseNotePanel for creating and editing case notes for a specific document. It provides UI elements for generating, saving, and copying case notes, and interacts with application context functions.

methods.name: CaseNotePanel
methods.description: React functional component rendering a UI panel for editing case notes associated with a document.

methods.name: onGenerate
methods.description: Triggers generation of a new case note for the given document and updates the component state.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current case note content for the document.

methods.name: onCopy
methods.description: Copies the current case note to the clipboard and provides visual feedback.
